{{Conjecture|legends}}
In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], a '''swoop gang''' was active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pembric II]]. Its members included [[Langre]] and [[Barksy]]. That year, while acting as security for a meeting of their gang at the [[ThrusterBurn Tapcafe]], members of the gang attempted to inflict injury upon [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] chief [[Talon Karrde]] and his bodyguard, [[Shada D'ukal]]. D'ukal, a [[Mistryl Shadow Guard]], dispatched three of them with ease, while Karrde handled the fourth.
